test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 04 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
On the basis of highest population growth rate (Census, 2011), select the option that arranges the following states in descending order.

A) Bihar

B) Arunachal Pradesh

C) Meghalaya
solution:
The correct answer is __**C, B, A**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Option 4** is the correct answer which arranges the states in **descending order of their population growth rate according to Census 2011**.
 
• The states in descending order of population growth rate are: **Meghalaya, Arunachal Pradesh, Bihar**.
